udt_union_v0.doc:
Curve (StableSwap-NG on Soroban) adapter.

Interface reverse-read from the testnet 3-coin pool
CB6PW7DRUI5GO652L7CRUOOPAZ4IBMWKQ7RCM7SGWFFF5YQKV6PIXFXN (2026-10-15):
Pool:    get_dy(i: u32, j: u32, dx: i128) -> i128
exchange(caller: Address, i: u32, j: u32, dx: i128, min_dy: i128,
receiver: MuxedAddress) -> i128
get_balances() -> Vec<i128>
Factory: pool_count() -> u32
pool_registration(pool_index: u32) -> PoolRegistration { pool, coins, ... }

Funds flow (ufama Router \xe2\x86\x92 this adapter):
The Router PUSHES token_in to this adapter, then invokes `swap`.
Curve's `exchange` pulls the input with a nested
`token_in.transfer(caller \xe2\x86\x92 pool, dx)` \xe2\x80\x94 verified from the testnet
simulation diagnostics (fn_call transfer [caller, pool, dx]) \xe2\x80\x94 so we
pre-authorize exactly that sub-invocation, the same way the Aqua
adapter does. Output is measured by balance delta and forwarded to
`recipient`.

Pool resolution: an admin-registered pin wins; otherwise the adapter
walks the factory registry (bounded) and picks the pool holdi
udt_union_v0.name: DataKey

tuple_v0.doc: Registered pool for an unordered pair (stored both directions)
tuple_v0.name: Pool

void_v0.doc: Two-step admin rotation: proposed new admin, pending acceptance.
void_v0.name: PendingAdmin

udt_struct_v0.doc: A Curve pool used for a pair.
udt_struct_v0.name: PoolInfo

fields.doc: The pool's coin list \xe2\x80\x94 order defines get_dy / exchange indexes
fields.name: coins

fields.doc: Pool contract address (also its LP token)
fields.name: pool_address

function_v0.doc:
Execute a single-hop swap through a Curve pool.

Expects `amount_in` of token_in to have been pushed to this contract
by the caller beforehand. Sends the output to `recipient` and returns
the actual amount out.
function_v0.name: swap

function_v0.doc: Quote a swap via the pool's own get_dy (the venue's math, fees\nincluded \xe2\x80\x94 Curve's dynamic off-peg fee is applied inside).
function_v0.name: quote

function_v0.doc: Pin the pool to use for a pair (both directions). Admin only.
function_v0.name: set_pool

function_v0.doc: Current factory; None while the adapter is unarmed.
function_v0.name: get_factory

function_v0.doc: Remove a pin so the factory resolver applies again. Admin only.
function_v0.name: remove_pool

function_v0.doc: Set (arm) or update the factory address. Admin only. On mainnet\nthis is the launch-day activation call.
function_v0.name: set_factory

function_v0.doc: Complete an admin rotation \xe2\x80\x94 callable only by the proposed admin.
function_v0.name: accept_admin

function_v0.doc: The pool this adapter would use for a pair (pin or resolver).
function_v0.name: get_pool_for

function_v0.doc: Deploy-time constructor. `factory` may be None: the adapter is\nthen dormant until `set_factory` arms it (mainnet launch pattern).
function_v0.name: __constructor

function_v0.doc: Propose a new admin (two-step rotation). Admin only.
function_v0.name: transfer_admin
